usage: policy should match build artifacts from artifactory
name: Artifactory image referencing build artifact must match by hash
description: A file found in your artifactory was matched to an artifact from your build system by name but not by hash.
detailedDescription: An artifactory image hash not matched to a build artifact may indicate an attempt to compromise your cloud account. An unauthorized application may be running in your organization's cloud. A crypto miner is an example of this.
